contrast_detail: motor imagery of fist (T1/T2) vs interleaved rest (T0), runs 4/8/12
note: active-task generalization cohort, erasure diagnostic only; NOT part of the 2x2 panel; different consensus marker (sensorimotor ERD)
preprocess: preprocess_v2_events (3 imagery runs concatenated -> ICA+ICLabel+autoreject+CAR, bandpass 0.5-45, notch 60); 4 s trial windows
caveats: 4 s trial windows here vs 5 s sliding windows on EEGMAT/ds004148 (intrinsic to the ~4 s motor-imagery trials); minor, recorded.
subj-BA chance floor 1/n_subj differs across cohorts; compare subj-BA/chance ratio, not raw subj-BA.
left-vs-right NOT computed (locked to MI-vs-rest); see PRIMARY_CONTRAST.

LaBraM pre-erasure label BA = 0.608 is the closest-to-gate of any erasure-helps replication recorded; its Δ_erase ±6.7 pp SD (3 seeds) is correspondingly the widest. Effect clearly positive but the weakest of the 3.

REVE post-erasure label BA 0.994 approaches ceiling; cross-cohort Δ_erase magnitude comparisons must account for this (do not read +26.7 pp here vs +13.9 pp on ds004148 as a clean effect-size difference).
REVE nonlinear residual (MLP-post) is dataset-dependent: 0.039 here vs 0.272 on ds004148. The d=512-vs-200 confound applies per-cohort, not as a fixed FM property.
